core_assessment: Reduce to a smooth projective curve and transfer the exterior product to a norm line bundle on its symmetric power. Construct a connected family showing the norm bundle is trivial on Abel–Jacobi projective-space fibres; descend it and kill its high Chern power by dimension.

editorial_notes: The displayed expansion of (sum c_1(L_i))^n has coefficient n!, not the printed n^n. Thus the displayed last coefficient should be ((n-1)!)^n n!, still a nonzero integer. The claimed torsion conclusion uses only a nonzero multiple and is unchanged. The original displays are retained.
In the family paragraph, the symbols M_p and M_q refer to the constructed L-prime fibres. This is a visible notation slip, not an additional line bundle.

The norm identity and projective-bundle description have author-marked omitted routine details. They are covered by the explicitly named standard norm and Abel–Jacobi inputs; no alternate source proof is inserted.
